from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs/task-585ba767.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The three-color seed is the horizontal sequence on the top edge.
    cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v != 0]
    colors = [grid[0][c] for c in cols]
    left_c, mid_c, right_c = cols[0], cols[1], cols[2]
    left_color, mid_color, right_color = colors
    # Connect outer seed colors to their matching side marker with an L-shaped path.
    left_marker = next((r for r in range(1, h) if grid[r][0] == left_color), None)
    if left_marker is not None:
        for r in range(left_marker + 1):
            out[r][left_c] = left_color
        for c in range(left_c + 1):
            out[left_marker][c] = left_color
    # The middle color runs down its column to the opposite edge.
    for r in range(h):
        out[r][mid_c] = mid_color
    right_marker = next(((r, c) for r in range(1, h) for c in range(w) if c != 0 and grid[r][c] == right_color), None)
    if right_marker is not None:
        r, c = right_marker
        for rr in range(r + 1):
            out[rr][right_c] = right_color
        for cc in range(right_c, w):
            out[r][cc] = right_color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
